trainedOn: CAL FIRE DINS (POSTFIRE_MASTER_DATA_SHARE): residential + commercial structures with all six features recorded

pitchStats.sentence: In Cal Fire's records for the Eaton Fire, buildings with unscreened or coarse vents were destroyed 43% of the time vs 24% with ember-resistant vents (≤1/8" mesh) (n=6,901 vs 1,277).

pitchStats.good: built 2008+ under the WUI fire code
pitchStats.sentence: In Cal Fire's records for the Eaton Fire, buildings with built before 1960 were destroyed 53% of the time vs 24% with built 2008+ under the WUI fire code (n=10,151 vs 70).
In Cal Fire's records for the Eaton Fire, buildings with wood or combustible roofs were destroyed 74% of the time vs 33% with tile/concrete roofs (n=42 vs 2,092).
In Cal Fire's records for the Eaton Fire, buildings with a combustible fence attached were destroyed 32% of the time vs 60% with no attached fence (n=3,831 vs 3,179).
In Cal Fire's records for the Eaton Fire, buildings with open eaves were destroyed 26% of the time vs 11% with enclosed eaves (n=5,675 vs 1,659).
In Cal Fire's records for the Eaton Fire, buildings with single-pane windows were destroyed 37% of the time vs 23% with multi-pane windows (n=4,674 vs 4,345).
In Cal Fire's records for the all CA fires since 2013, buildings with unscreened or coarse vents were destroyed 56% of the time vs 45% with ember-resistant vents (≤1/8" mesh) (n=30,986 vs 15,735).
